messages:
Ava: ok team  planning a 4-week push of tiny, hands-on refapp tutorials + an OSS launch post. goal: 1) quick wins for devs, 2) inbound capture with mini labs, 3) a benchmark narrative we can reuse. thoughts? :sparkles:
Diego: love it. short, snackable steps are clutch. can we do 3 levels: quickstart (5m), integration (20m), pro tips (40m)?
Priya: yes  and call out cost/perf tips from Redwood Optimize for each level. people ask about latency/cost tradeoffs a lot.
Samir: timeline? I can spin up demo infra and record screenflows. thinking: Week1 content authoring, Week2 recording + code samples, Week3 QA + blog draft, Week4 publish + webinar.
Molly: for the OSS post copy, we should highlight contributor checklist + license note. also add a short migration guide for folks using other runtimes.
Ava: agreed. Diego and Priya  can you draft the content outline by EOD Friday? Samir  can you confirm infra availability (GPU pools + sample dataset)?
Diego: outline ack. will include a small benchmark section comparing default model vs quantized variant  rough numbers and a callout to Redwood Optimize suggestions.
Priya: adding a prompt + eval snippet and a minimal curl example for the quickstart. example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-2","prompt":"Summarize: ..."}'
Samir: infra ok. I reserved a dev pool for Wed-Fri next week. sample dataset: small customer support corpus (anonymized). will provide an S3 link.
Molly: can design prepare 3 hero images and 1 explainer gif? also need a short tweet thread and LinkedIn copy.
Ava: ops-bot  schedule a 30m sync for Tue 10am and create a checklist in the repo.
ops-bot: created calendar event "refapp snackables kickoff" Tue 10:00  invites sent to Ava, Diego, Priya, Samir, Molly. repo checklist added at https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/snackables/board
Diego: for the benchmark narrative, lean into real cost savings: show tokens/sec, average latency, and per-1k-token cost before/after batching+quantization. keep numbers rounded.
Priya: also include a short eval harness snippet and link to the eval repo. we can surface an 'expected outputs' file for regressions.
Ava: we should run a small closed beta: invite 10 community devs to try the mini lab, gather qualitative feedback, and include quotes in the blog.
Molly: marketing assets plan: tweet thread (3 tweets), linkedin post, short demo video (90s), and a how-to gist for the code.
Samir: I'll export console logs and sample perf tables. propose we publish the benchmark appendix as CSV in the repo for transparency.
Priya: will write the call-to-action: "Try the snackable refapp  free tier credits + community cohort" with a link to signup and the mini lab.
Diego: can we have a small A/B test on the landing page: Benchmark-first vs Quickstart-first? track signups and time-to-first-run.
Ava: yes. Molly  prepare both headlines. Samir  tag the demo images with model/quant settings. ops-bot  add task for AB experiment tracking.
ops-bot: added tasks: AB-test landing, upload benchmark CSV, record demo video. See board: https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/snackables/board
Ava: great. next sync Tue. keep copy short and developer-focused. :rocket:
